data.body: Intent Gate: intent-aligned (manual). The Jira bridge's stated purpose per outbound-bridge.yml header ('Pushes local ticket changes to Jira') and inbound-bridge.yml ('Pulls Jira changes into local ticket system') is bidirectional sync. Both symptoms (status-not-syncing, type=epic-not-creating) directly contradict that intent. No conflicting callers — the sync IS the contract.
